cohort: 53 women with refractory PPH who underwent balloon tamponade after failed medical management, aged 20 to 35 years (mean age 24.81 +/- 4.468 years), with estimated blood loss ranging from 700 to 2000 mL (mean 1260.38 +/- 333.02 mL).
finding: Balloon tamponade alone had a success rate of 84.90% in controlling refractory PPH, and when combined with other surgical interventions, the overall success rate increased to 98.11%.
